composition_recipes.name: Cinematic Landing Page
composition_recipes.use_case: Landing page with scroll reveals, parallax, smooth scrolling
composition_recipes.notes: GSAP handles scroll choreography, Lenis provides smooth scroll foundation. ~28kB total.
composition_recipes.key_code_pattern: gsap.context() + ScrollTrigger pin:true + Lenis RAF loop

composition_recipes.name: Portfolio with Transitions
composition_recipes.use_case: Portfolio with page transitions, card hover effects, loading animations
composition_recipes.notes: Motion for page transitions (AnimatePresence), React Spring for gesture-driven hover (useSpring api), Anime.js for micro-details (stagger).

composition_recipes.name: 3D Product Viewer with Scroll
composition_recipes.use_case: 3D product that rotates on scroll with colorway reveals
composition_recipes.notes: Three.js for 3D rendering, GSAP for scroll-linked rotation, Lenis for smooth scroll. Lazy-load Three.js for bundle size.
composition_recipes.key_code_pattern: Canvas + ScrollTrigger scrub + Lenis RAF loop

composition_recipes.name: Lightweight Scroll Animations
composition_recipes.use_case: Performance-critical site with simple scroll reveals, tight bundle budget
composition_recipes.notes: Trig.js (~2kB) for scroll triggers, Lenis (~3kB) for smooth scroll. Total ~5kB. Use when GSAP is too heavy.

composition_recipes.name: Mobile-First Premium Animation
composition_recipes.use_case: Site with 80%+ mobile traffic, needs animation on desktop but performance on mobile
composition_recipes.notes: Use ScrollTrigger.matchMedia() for responsive animations. Desktop: full pinned sections. Mobile: simple reveals.

composition_recipes.name: Svelte Premium Site
composition_recipes.use_case: Creative portfolio in Svelte with scroll effects and transitions
composition_recipes.notes: GSAP works directly in Svelte. Use onMount/onDestroy instead of useEffect. Motion has motion-svelte package.

composition_recipes.name: Dashboard with Mixed Interactions
composition_recipes.use_case: Dashboard with sidebar transitions, drag-to-rearrange, theme toggle
composition_recipes.notes: Motion for component transitions (sidebar, toggle). React Spring for gesture-driven drag (useSpring api.start).

composition_recipes.name: Accessible Premium Animation
composition_recipes.use_case: Site that needs premium animations but must respect prefers-reduced-motion
composition_recipes.notes: Check window.matchMedia(prefers-reduced-motion) before animating. CSS @media fallback. Show content immediately when reduced motion preferred.

anti_patterns.name: Animate layout properties
anti_patterns.description: Animating width, height, top, left causes layout reflows. Use transform and opacity instead.
anti_patterns.detection_signal: Janky animations, layout shifts during animation
anti_patterns.fix: Use scale + opacity or translateX/Y instead

anti_patterns.name: Missing GSAP cleanup in React
anti_patterns.description: GSAP animations created in useEffect without gsap.context() cleanup accumulate ScrollTrigger instances.
anti_patterns.detection_signal: Site gets slower after navigating between pages
anti_patterns.fix: Wrap in gsap.context(), return ctx.revert() in cleanup. Or use useGSAP hook.

anti_patterns.name: Loading unnecessary animation libraries
anti_patterns.description: Shipping GSAP + Framer Motion + Anime.js when only one is needed.
anti_patterns.fix: Pick the minimum set. Lenis + GSAP covers 80% of cases.

anti_patterns.name: Using Framer Motion for scroll choreography
anti_patterns.description: Framer Motion can't pin sections, scrub to scroll position, or sequence multi-element timelines.
anti_patterns.detection_signal: User asks for pinned sections with Framer Motion
anti_patterns.fix: Redirect to GSAP ScrollTrigger. Explain why.

anti_patterns.name: Ignoring prefers-reduced-motion
anti_patterns.description: Not checking user motion preferences. Some users get nauseous from animations.
anti_patterns.fix: Check matchMedia(prefers-reduced-motion) before animating. CSS @media fallback.

anti_patterns.name: No mobile animation adaptation
anti_patterns.description: Using same animation complexity on mobile as desktop. Causes jank on older devices.

anti_patterns.name: Over-animating
anti_patterns.description: Animating every element. If everything moves, nothing stands out.
anti_patterns.fix: Animate only what serves a purpose: guide attention, create hierarchy, or add delight.

learned_compositions.description: Framer Motion is fine for simple viewport-enter animations (fade-in, slide-up)
learned_compositions.rule: Don't redirect to GSAP if user only needs whileInView

learned_compositions.description: Motion and React Spring can coexist on the same site without conflicts
learned_compositions.rule: Motion for page transitions, React Spring for gesture-driven — they don't overlap

learned_compositions.description: Three.js lazy-loading is essential for bundle-conscious projects
learned_compositions.rule: Always suggest dynamic import for Three.js unless user explicitly wants full bundle

learned_compositions.description: CSS 3D transforms can replace Three.js for simple rotation
learned_compositions.rule: If 3D is just rotation (no orbit/zoom/geometry), CSS perspective + rotateY is sufficient

learned_compositions.description: useGSAP hook is cleaner than manual gsap.context() for new code
learned_compositions.rule: Recommend useGSAP for new components, gsap.context() for existing codebases
